truth_scope: Official source category: presence of attacked synthetic injected identifiers versus ordinary or PII-shaped negative source categories. Not exhaustive five-type truth, whole-prompt privacy-clean truth, contextual relevance, severity, visibility or action truth.
prediction_scope: Any native semantic finding for fixed balanced V1 and AU3 V3, explicit sole request and actual returned layer [4], empty visibility hints, no gate. Broader semantic ontology mismatches official source categories; report raw binary response reference only.

sampling.algorithm: Compute full closure first, exclude protected/conflicting components, rank eligible components per stratum by SHA256(seed|stratum|component_id), skip globally used components; choose minimum SHA256(seed|row|uid) member in each admitted component. Stop before inference if any quota or component floor fails; no replacement after inference.

closure.identifier_normalization: entity type plus NFKC/casefold native value, remove Unicode whitespace; never value_fuzzy
closure.conflict: exclude entire component for opposing official binary category on equal exact or shared normalized text

protection.known_scope: opaque old development/final parent selection; V1 original training/validation/bootstrap; known Nemotron/Meddies expansion training and heldouts; additionally current V3 training manifests must be checked before inference
protection.unknown_scope: Upstream pretrained encoder corpus, semantic paraphrases and undisclosed template families cannot be excluded by these keys.

baseline.name: presidio-five-type-lg
baseline.scope: restricted native taxonomy reference, still source category proxy

metrics.errors: retain separately; report complete-case confusion plus conservative all-row recall/specificity treating errors as misses for their source class; any error invalidates comparative conclusion

paired_uncertainty.comparison: V3 minus V1 recall and specificity
paired_uncertainty.interval: percentile 95%; same resampled components both arms

limitations: Synthetic English single-turn inference-time attacks; released split named train is not author held-out evaluation.
One sampled variant per closure limits repeated-prompt dependence but does not prove independent templates.
Native labels annotate the attacked identifier only; prior exhaustive five-identifier ontology proposal is unsuitable without new review.
Broad semantic positivity can be correct for unannotated categories and still disagree with this source proxy.
No result settles contextual privacy generalization or product end-to-end accuracy.
